intro: A Clue to Sanders' Treasure is a weathered parchment left behind by the notorious pirate Captain Sanders. It serves as the second step in a treasure hunt scattered across the bluffs and coastlines of Westfall.

p: Discovered after following Captain Sanders' initial treasure map, this parchment provides directions further inland into Westfall. The scrawled note directs the finder due east from the coast, urging them to climb up the bluffs toward the main road. Sanders hid his next marker inside an old barrel resting near the crumbling stone ruins of an abandoned chimney, leading seekers deeper into the troubled farmlands.
